events.detail: Parcel was assigned to a van route because of its size.
Driver closed the stop as a drop-off at the dwelling entrance.
The driver loaded multiple shipments for nearby stops.
Driver attached a safe-place photo to the delivery scan.

proof_of_delivery.detail: The pictured shed matches the location note, but the visible label is linked to a different shipment.

events.detail: Recipient could not accept the tall carton near the loading entrance.
Counter hold ended and the branch loaded the carton for its return run.
Retailer warehouse scanned the returned mirror and matched the sales label.
The residence's receiving desk reported the named occupant had moved out.
Carrier redirected the parcel to merchant returns.
Retailer intake recorded the boxed stand and matched it by order label.
Parcel loaded for the first neighborhood route of the day.
Driver recorded a handoff to the duty guard.

proof_of_delivery.detail: The signature line contains a single mark with no identifying characters or intake entry.

events.detail: Carrier loaded the shipment for deposit at an automated cabinet.
Correct cabinet recorded a drop-off linked to this tracking ID.

proof_of_delivery.detail: The proof photo shows the expected cabinet and the matching parcel label.

events.detail: The recipient asked for handoff at a neighboring shop. Staff at that shop declined the bulky parcel.
Branch redirected the carton to the retailer after the recipient declined another delivery attempt.
Regional carrier depot staged the return for the next truck.
A plant room closure blocked access to the receiving station.
Parcel sent back after the requested later delivery window could not be arranged.
Warehouse intake scanned the unopened cookware carton.
The driver loaded the parcel with a consolidated neighborhood route.
Carrier saved a parcel label photo as proof of delivery.

proof_of_delivery.detail: Carrier manifest links the photographed label to a separate order.

events.detail: Parcel loaded for residential and workshop deliveries.
The delivery scan lists a shared package rack and has no attachment.
Carrier address validation flagged a missing building entrance designation.
Parcel sent back at the end of the address-correction window.
Carrier regional return scan confirmed arrival at its transfer hub.
Warehouse intake scanned the original label at the bulky returns dock.
The driver could not reach the customer at the booked stop.
Carrier closed its ticket and routed the unused parcel back to the retailer.
Retailer warehouse accepted the original blanket and scanned the label.
Parcel left the branch with the midday residential route.
Driver closed the stop without attaching proof.
Destination branch assigned the parcel to its residential belt.
Driver saved a delivery photo on the agreed utility shelf.

proof_of_delivery.detail: The photo shows the shelf agreed with the customer and the shipment label.

events.detail: Customer asked the driver to route the undelivered carton to a collection counter.
Carrier checked the parcel in for collection.
Collection window expired, and the carrier transferred the carton for return.
Warehouse scanned the return and reported the original carton damaged.
A site manager refused access to the installation unit.
Carrier sealed the main-unit carton for the merchant return truck.
Intake identified and scanned the returned main unit.
The driver carried parcels for two adjacent buildings with managed reception.
Carrier attached the service desk's signed receipt.

proof_of_delivery.detail: The reception stamp on the signed receipt identifies the adjacent building, which differs from the shipment destination.

events.detail: Parcel loaded for an extended route.
Driver recorded a shared parcel table drop-off on the handheld.
The destination branch sent a second delivery scan after reconciling its manifest.

proof_of_delivery.detail: The second scan has no named recipient. A cropped mark is attached without readable details.

events.detail: Driver found the community room closed and could not hand over the parcel.
Carrier sorted the parcel onto a warehouse-bound route.
The destination depot recorded return staging after a truck delay.
Driver could not complete delivery using the existing flat access instructions.
Parcel was loaded onto the merchant return vehicle.
Returns staff registered the order's intact parcel upon arrival.
Parcel assigned to a mixed workshop delivery run.
Carrier recorded a successful one-time code check before closing the stop.

proof_of_delivery.detail: The code matches this shipment and the customer confirms providing it.

events.detail: The route manifest lists the current parcel cabinet for this order.
The driver took a photo of the parcel bay at drop-off.

proof_of_delivery.detail: The carrier reviewed the image and confirmed the pictured bay is in an adjacent building.

events.detail: No one was present for the prepaid handoff.
Local branch moved the parcel to a short collection hold.
End-of-hold scan routed the parcel back.
Warehouse checked the serving set into returns.
No recipient was available for the requested signed handoff.
Second attempt ended without a signature.
Carrier processed the parcel into the reverse lane after both attempts.
